blocks.html:
This method retrieves a locale by its code. It sends a request to the
[Get Locale](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#locales\_getlocalescode) API route.

types.name: code
types.description: The locale's code in BCP 47 format.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the locale.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the locale was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the locale was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the locale was deleted.
